analysis: The dropout ablation executed successfully but reduced validation HR@10 from 0.665 to 0.620, a decline of 0.045 (nine fewer hits across 200 users). The host selected epoch 10; 30 epochs completed. Lower dropout did not improve this configuration, favoring retention of 0.2. Reduced regularization is a plausible explanation, but this single seed does not establish the mechanism. No test metric was used.
code_summary: Position-free causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, maximum sequence length 128, and eight independent blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8] and kernel size 3. Each block mixes gated local and dilated convolutions, then applies a second dilated convolution, LayerNorm, GELU, dropout, and learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1. Only DROPOUT_RATE and the model constructor dropout default changed to 0.1, propagating to embedding and residual-branch dropout. Padding masks, candidate scoring, interfaces, other hyperparameters, and the frozen host were preserved.
